courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 深層攪拌樁地盤改良
related.transfer: 可遷移「沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證」與「效率隨歷程變化的機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；深層攪拌樁地盤改良的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification" and "History-dependent efficiency mechanism and verification" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦補償灌漿的變形回饋、注入效率與延遲；深層攪拌樁地盤改良則以攪拌均勻度、膠結反應與複合地盤沉陷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on compensation-grouting movement feedback, efficiency and delay; Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement centres on mixing uniformity, binder reaction and composite-ground settlement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「沉陷槽形狀」與「原土含水比」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到深層攪拌樁地盤改良，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「殘餘強度的機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Settlement-trough shape” and “Native-soil water content”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Residual strength mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 補償灌漿沉陷控制
history.text: 補償灌漿透過受控的地層變形降低隧道施工對資產的沉陷影響，其目標是控制差異變形而非追求最大抬升。本課把沉陷槽、注入效率、孔位誤差、有效應力及回饋延遲連成模型，再檢查結構角變形、曲率與停止注入後的殘餘反應。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Compensation grouting controls ground deformation to reduce settlement effects from tunnelling, targeting differential movement rather than maximum heave. The course connects settlement troughs, injection efficiency, bore position, effective stress and feedback delay, then evaluates structural distortion, curvature and residual movement after injection stops. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
